categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in precision metal processing, producing automotive parts including commercial vehicle engine system energy-saving and emission reduction components, pneumatic disc brake calipers, brake pad backplates, turbocharger bent pipes and accessories, flywheel housings, rocker arm housings, exhaust manifolds, brackets, mandrels, wind power brake system parts, and various industrial machinery components. It also develops green energy parts and serves multiple industries such as automotive, wind power, agricultural machinery, and construction machinery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced precision metal processing technologies including casting, forging, high-precision machining, heat treatment, surface treatment (anodizing, hard anodizing, inorganic zinc primer coating), and assembly. It employs innovative manufacturing methods such as automated production lines, 3D printing for prototype development, reverse engineering, and specialized jig and fixture design to enhance product quality and production efficiency. The company also focuses on lightweight aluminum alloy components and integrates multi-material composite processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major international commercial vehicle manufacturers and first-tier suppliers, primarily in the commercial truck and green energy vehicle sectors. The company serves markets in automotive OEMs, wind power generation, agricultural machinery, and construction machinery industries. Major customers include companies labeled as A, C, D, and F, with significant sales in North America, Asia, and other regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and China (Fuzhou), with subsidiaries in the Cayman Islands, Samoa, and the United States. Its sales markets cover North America, Asia, and other countries, with a significant portion of revenue generated from the Americas and Asia. The company is expanding production capacity in Taiwan and the U.S. to mitigate geopolitical risks and trade tensions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on precision metal component manufacturing and assembly. It sources raw materials such as cast iron and aluminum from upstream suppliers and delivers finished components to downstream OEMs and system integrators in the automotive and industrial machinery sectors. It also engages in vertical integration through subsidiaries to strengthen supply chain control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing lightweight aluminum alloy products for engine and chassis components to meet energy-saving and emission regulations, expanding into green energy vehicle parts, and enhancing automation and smart manufacturing capabilities. The company emphasizes R&D in advanced manufacturing processes, materials innovation, and product design optimization to shorten customer development cycles and reduce costs. It also focuses on digital marketing, supply chain diversification, and sustainability initiatives aligned with ESG goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of precision metal automotive and industrial components. The company offers customized, small-batch, multi-variety production services and one-stop procurement solutions including precision machining, surface treatment, assembly, testing, and logistics. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but on direct sales to OEMs and industrial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other precision metal processing firms in Taiwan and China, many of which focus on passenger vehicle components or aftermarket parts. It differentiates itself by specializing in commercial vehicle and green energy vehicle components with a broad product application range and strong customer relationships. Its competitive advantages include flexible production, advanced technology integration, and a focus on niche markets with less direct competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported net revenue of approximately NT$1.08 billion, a 9.56% decrease from 2023, and a net profit of NT$170 million, down 16.3%. Despite revenue decline due to economic slowdown in Europe, the company maintained a gross margin of 32.5% and a net profit margin of 15.71%. It has a stable financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio of 36.39% and continues to invest in capacity expansion and automation. The company plans to grow shipments in 2025 based on stable existing orders and new product launches.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-precision, customized metal components with a focus on commercial vehicles and green energy applications, providing customers with integrated solutions from design to delivery. Its value proposition includes advanced manufacturing technologies, flexible production capacity for small-batch and multi-variety orders, and strong R&D collaboration with customers to optimize product design and reduce development time and costs. The company also emphasizes quality management, sustainability, and compliance with international standards to enhance customer satisfaction and competitive positioning.
